name: Jade Circular Table Screen with Decoration of Figures in a Landscape on the Front and Trees and Mountains on the Back
dimensions: Diam. 18.0 x Thickness (max.) 1.4 cm (7 1/16 x 9/16 in.)
summary: The slightly curved front depicts a scholar looking over the railing of a riverside pavilion at rolling waves; the flat back contains a scene of trees and mountains in low relief.
